messages:
Kate: Heads up — espresso machine in the kitchen spat out a `PUMP ERROR 503` and won't brew :frowning:. Also we're low on oat milk and the pantry is out of almond butter. Can someone swing by nearby café or grocery? I'll leave a note on the machine.
Ben: I can go grab oat milk and croissants in ~20. Anything else?
Alice: If you're at the co-op, grab fair-trade beans? Small bag is fine — just for the office stash. Also: someone left homemade banana bread on the counter :banana:.
Ben: Saving that for after my 1pm sync :raised_hands:. Where should I put the receipt?
Priya: There's a receipt folder on the kitchen shelf. Also could you pick up sugar packets and a pack of replacement filters if they have them?
Marco: Also please log a facilities ticket for the machine — it's showing the same pump error after the third brew. Might be the pump sensor.
kitchen-bot: REMINDER: Please label any dairy alternatives in the fridge. New oat milk should be labeled 'Oat - Opened 3/1'.
Kate: Thanks Ben! Whiteboard list reads: oat milk, almond butter, croissants, sugar packets. Ben — card or cash?
Ben: Card is fine. I'll drop the receipt in #expenses and leave a paper copy in the folder.
Alice: Quick note — taco lunch on Friday so try to keep snacks until then :taco:.
Josh: Also who left the giant jar of pickles in the sink area? :eyes: (not complaining, just curious)
Ben: Back — grabbed oat milk (Oatly), croissants, and cookies. Left receipt in the kitchen receipt folder and uploaded to #expenses.
Kate: Legend :heart: I put a sticky on the machine: 'DO NOT USE — Facilities notified'. Marco, please paste the ticket ID here when you have it.
Marco: Ticket #F-2147 opened. Facilities ETA ~48 hours. Temporary workaround: use the French press in the cupboard (instructions taped above it).
Priya: Thanks — I've labeled the banana bread: 'From Priya — take two slices max :wink:'. Also added almond butter to my grocery list, I can bring it tomorrow.
kitchen-bot: NOTE: Snack inventory updated: oat_milk=2, almond_butter=0, croissants=6, sugar_packets=50.
Alice: I'll bring a jar of almond butter tomorrow AM. Also I have a decaf bag at my desk if anyone wants — ping me.
Kate: Appreciate everyone! I'll update the kitchen notes doc with ticket #F-2147 and a reminder to log receipts.
